name: Porchlight
what_it_does: Volunteer matching for Lowcountry nonprofits. Volunteers pick causes and free hours, and Porchlight lists nearby shifts from food banks, river cleanups, and animal shelters with one-click signup.
target_user: Charleston residents who want to volunteer but do not know which nonprofits need help this week.

agent_observations.note: Porchlight is clear and accessible, but reviewers said it feels like other volunteer boards (feels_distinctive 0.4). It needs a reason to exist beyond a list of shifts.
